title: Laxmi Dahal Rawal Announces Candidacy for DLA-Nepal President - Ratopati
description: Laxmi Dahal Rawal Announces Candidacy for DLA-Nepal President  Ratopati
publisher.title: Ratopati
full_article: Kathmandu. Former General Secretary Laxmi Dahal Rawal has announced her candidacy for the upcoming 12th General Convention of the Democratic Lawyers Association (DLA-Nepal) to be held on Bhadra 19 and 20. Rawal, who was the closest competitor for the presidency in the 11th General Convention, told reporters that she will once again contest for the presidency this time. Rawal, who was elected General Secretary from the 10th General Convention, is also a former central member of the Nepal Bar Association. Rawal has announced her candidacy and a 10-point action plan with the main slogan 'Leadership of Experience, Transformation of the Organization'. She said that her candidacy is to enable women to reach the leadership as there has been no woman president in DLA so far. Rawal states that her candidacy is not just because she is a woman, but based on her loyalty to the organization, performance capability, and clear vision. She says, 'I am not looking for a post, but for an opportunity to fulfill responsibility. My candidacy is a common campaign for merit, inclusive leadership, and institutional transformation.' The commitment letter released by Rawal includes operating DLA free from any external interference and factionalism according to the rule of law, protecting the independent judiciary, technology-friendly DLA, enhancing members' capacity, and constructing the organization's own building. DLA is an organization of lawyers close to the Nepali Congress.

title: Indian Army Chief General Dhiraj Seth in Nepal - Myanmar International TV
description: Indian Army Chief General Dhiraj Seth in Nepal  Myanmar International TV
publisher.title: Myanmar International TV
full_article:
Indian Chief of the Army Staff, General Dhiraj Seth, inspected the Guard of Honour, at Army Headquarters in Kathmandu, during his three-day official visit to Nepal.

During his three-day official visit to Nepal, General Seth laid a wreath at the Army Pavilion, paying tribute to the strong bonds shared by the armed forces of the two countries. Later on Monday, General Seth attended an Investiture Ceremony at Rashtrapati Bhawan in Kathmandu, where President of Nepal Ram Chandra Paudel conferred upon him the honorary rank of General of the Nepali Army.

The conferment of the honorary rank reflects the longstanding tradition of mutual respect and close military ties between the two neighbouring countries. The visit underscored the longstanding and close defence partnership between India and Nepal.

title: Nepal PM Balendra Shah Felicitates Narendra Modi on Indian Independence Day - dailyasianage.com
description: Nepal PM Balendra Shah Felicitates Narendra Modi on Indian Independence Day  dailyasianage.com
publisher.title: dailyasianage.com
full_article:
Nepal and India share a relationship based on geographical proximity, cultural connections, religious links, economic cooperation and extensive people-to-people contacts. -Telegraph





Nepal Prime Minister Balendra Shah extended warm greetings to Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi and the people of India on the occasion of India's 80th Independence Day on Saturday, highlighting the close historical ties and enduring friendship between the two neighbouring countries.

Shah's message came as India celebrated its Independence Day with ceremonies across the country and by Indian communities abroad. In his message, the Nepali prime minister conveyed his best wishes to Modi and the people of India and expressed hope that the longstanding relationship between Nepal and India would continue to grow stronger in the years ahead.





"May the deep historical ties, close people-to-people relations and cooperation between Nepal and India continue to strengthen in the years ahead," Shah said in his Independence Day message.





The message assumes particular significance as Shah, who became Nepal's prime minister in March this year, begins his tenure with a focus on strengthening Nepal's relations with its neighbours and expanding cooperation for the mutual benefit of the two countries. Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi had congratulated Shah after he took office, saying that his appointment reflected the trust placed in his leadership by the people of Nepal. Modi also expressed his willingness to work closely with Shah to take India-Nepal friendship and cooperation to greater heights.





Nepal and India share a relationship based on geographical proximity, cultural connections, religious links, economic cooperation and extensive people-to-people contacts. Citizens of the two countries have long maintained close social and family connections across the open border. Thousands of Nepalis work, study and travel in India, while Indian citizens have strong economic and cultural links with Nepal.





The two countries also cooperate in areas including trade, energy, infrastructure, tourism, education and connectivity. Rivers and waterways flowing between the countries make cooperation on water resources and flood management particularly important. Greater cooperation in these areas can contribute to economic development and improve the livelihoods of people living in border regions.





Shah's message also comes at a time when India is celebrating a major national milestone. Independence Day commemorates India's independence from British colonial rule in 1947. Across India, the national flag was hoisted at government institutions, schools and public places, while cultural programs and public celebrations were held. Indians living abroad also joined the celebrations and marked the occasion with patriotic events.





The Indian Embassy in Kathmandu also observed India's 80th Independence Day. The celebration included the singing of Vande Mataram and the hoisting of the Indian national flag by Ambassador Naveen Srivastava. The event reflected the strong diplomatic and people-to-people connections between Nepal and India.





Diplomatic observers say cordial messages exchanged between the leaders of neighbouring countries can help reinforce mutual understanding and goodwill. For Nepal and India, maintaining regular high-level communication is particularly important because of their close geographical and social relationship.





There are also many areas where the two countries can expand cooperation. Greater cross-border connectivity, improved trade facilities, tourism promotion, energy partnerships and educational exchanges could create new opportunities for citizens of both countries. Nepal has significant hydropower potential, while India remains an important market and partner for Nepal's economic development. Stronger cooperation in energy could therefore benefit both sides.





At the same time, the relationship between neighbours inevitably involves challenges. Issues relating to trade, border management, water resources and infrastructure require continuous dialogue and mutual understanding. Constructive engagement between the two governments can help address such matters peacefully and prevent misunderstandings from affecting broader bilateral relations.





Shah's Independence Day greeting is thus more than a ceremonial message. It signals Nepal's interest in maintaining friendly and productive relations with India under his new administration. Modi's earlier message of cooperation similarly indicates India's desire to deepen ties with Nepal.





As both countries look toward the future, cooperation based on mutual respect, equality and shared interests will remain essential. The friendship between Nepal and India has deep roots, but its future will depend on how effectively both sides respond to new economic, social and regional challenges.





Prime Minister Balendra Shah's greetings to Narendra Modi on India's Independence Day therefore serve as a reminder of the importance of neighbourly relations in South Asia. Continued dialogue, stronger people-to-people contacts and practical cooperation can help Nepal and India build an even closer partnership in the years ahead.

नेपाल आ भारत भौगोलिक निकटता, सांस्कृतिक संपर्क, धार्मिक संबंध, आर्थिक सहयोग आ व्यापक जन-जन संपर्क पर आधारित संबंध साझा करैत अछि । -टेलीग्राफ





नेपाल केरऽ प्रधानमन्त्री बलेन्द्र शाह न॑ शनिदिन भारत केरऽ ८०वां स्वतंत्रता दिवस के अवसर प॑ भारतीय प्रधानमंत्री नरेन्द्र मोदी आरू भारत केरऽ जनता क॑ हार्दिक शुभकामना देलकै, जेकरा म॑ दूनू पड़ोसी देशऽ के बीच घनिष्ठ ऐतिहासिक संबंध आरू स्थायी दोस्ती प॑ प्रकाश डाललऽ गेलै ।

शाह केरऽ ई संदेश ऐसनऽ समय म॑ ऐलै जब॑ भारत न॑ देश भर म॑ आरू विदेशऽ म॑ भारतीय समुदाय द्वारा अपनऽ स्वतंत्रता दिवस समारोह के साथ मनाबै के काम करलकै । नेपाली प्रधानमंत्री अपन संदेश मे मोदी आ भारतक जनता केँ शुभकामना दैत आशा व्यक्त केलनि जे आगामी वर्ष मे नेपाल आ भारतक बीच दीर्घकालीन संबंध मजबूत होइत रहत।





शाह अपन स्वतंत्रता दिवस संदेश मे कहलनि जे, नेपाल आ भारतक बीच गहींर ऐतिहासिक संबंध, घनिष्ठ जन-जन सम्बन्ध आ सहयोग आगामी वर्ष मे मजबूत होइत रहय।





ई संदेश विशेष महत्व ग्रहण करै छै, कैन्हेंकि ई साल मार्च म॑ नेपाल केरऽ प्रधानमंत्री बनलऽ शाह न॑ अपनऽ कार्यकाल के शुरुआत अपनऽ पड़ोसी देशऽ के साथ नेपाल केरऽ संबंध क॑ मजबूत करै आरू दूनू देश केरऽ आपसी लाभ लेली सहयोग के विस्तार प॑ ध्यान केंद्रित करी क॑ करलकै । भारतीय प्रधानमंत्री नरेन्द्र मोदी शाह के पदभार ग्रहण के बाद बधाई दैत कहने छलाह जे हुनकर नियुक्ति मे नेपाल के जनता द्वारा हुनकर नेतृत्व पर राखल गेल विश्वास के झलक भेटैत अछि । मोदी न॑ भारत-नेपाल केरऽ दोस्ती आरू सहयोग क॑ आरू ऊंचाई प॑ पहुँचै लेली शाह के साथ मिल क॑ काम करै के इच्छा भी व्यक्त करलकै ।





नेपाल आ भारत भौगोलिक निकटता, सांस्कृतिक संपर्क, धार्मिक संबंध, आर्थिक सहयोग आ व्यापक जन-जन संपर्क पर आधारित संबंध साझा करैत अछि । दूनू देशक नागरिक बहुत दिन स खुला सीमा पार क घनिष्ठ सामाजिक आ पारिवारिक संबंध बनौने छथि। हजारों नेपाली भारत मे काज करैत छथि, पढ़ैत छथि आ यात्रा करैत छथि, जखन कि भारतीय नागरिकक नेपाल सँ मजबूत आर्थिक आ सांस्कृतिक संबंध अछि ।





दुनू देश व्यापार, ऊर्जा, बुनियादी ढांचा, पर्यटन, शिक्षा आ कनेक्टिविटी सहित क्षेत्र मे सेहो सहयोग करैत अछि । देशक कें बीच बहय वाला नदी आ जलमार्ग जल संसाधन आ बाढ़ प्रबंधन पर सहयोग कें विशेष रूप सं महत्वपूर्ण बनायत छै. अइ क्षेत्रक मे बेसि सहयोग आर्थिक विकास मे योगदान द सकय छै आ सीमावर्ती क्षेत्रक मे रहय वाला लोगक कें आजीविका मे सुधार कयर सकय छै.





शाह केरऽ ई संदेश ऐन्हऽ समय म॑ भी आबी रहलऽ छै जब॑ भारत एगो बड़ऽ राष्ट्रीय मील के पत्थर मनाबै छै । स्वतंत्रता दिवस 1947 मे ब्रिटिश औपनिवेशिक शासन स भारत क आजादी क याद मे मनाउल जाइत अछि।पूरे भारत मे सरकारी संस्थान, स्कूल आ सार्वजनिक स्थान पर राष्ट्रीय ध्वज फहराउल गेल, जखन कि सांस्कृतिक कार्यक्रम आ सार्वजनिक उत्सव क आयोजन कैल गेल। विदेश मे रहय वाला भारतीय सेहो एहि उत्सव मे शामिल भेलाह आओर देशभक्ति के आयोजन सं एहि अवसर के मनाओलखिन्ह.





काठमांडू स्थित भारतीय दूतावास भारतक ८०म स्वतंत्रता दिवस सेहो मनौलक । उत्सव में वंदे मातरम के गायन आरू राजदूत नवीन श्रीवास्तव द्वारा भारतीय राष्ट्रीय ध्वज फहराबै के आयोजन करलऽ गेलै । एहि आयोजन मे नेपाल आ भारतक बीच मजबूत कूटनीतिक आ जन-जन संबंधक झलक देखबा मे आयल ।





कूटनीतिक पर्यवेक्षकऽ के कहना छै कि पड़ोसी देशऽ के नेता सिनी के बीच आदान-प्रदान करलऽ जाय वाला सौहार्दपूर्ण संदेश आपसी समझदारी आरू सद्भावना क॑ मजबूत करै म॑ मदद करी सकै छै । नेपाल आ भारतक लेल नियमित उच्च स्तरीय संचार कायम राखब विशेष रूप सँ महत्वपूर्ण अछि, कारण ओकर घनिष्ठ भौगोलिक आ सामाजिक संबंध अछि ।





संगहि बहुत रास क्षेत्र अछि जतय दुनू देश सहयोग के विस्तार क सकैत अछि। सीमा पार सं बेसि संपर्क, बेहतर व्यापार सुविधा, पर्यटन संवर्धन, ऊर्जा साझेदारी आ शैक्षिक आदान-प्रदान दूनू देशक कें नागरिकक कें लेल नव अवसर पैदा कयर सकय छै. नेपाल मे जलविद्युतक महत्वपूर्ण संभावना अछि, जखन कि भारत नेपालक आर्थिक विकासक लेल एकटा महत्वपूर्ण बाजार आ भागीदार बनल अछि । एहि लेल ऊर्जा मे मजबूत सहयोग स दुनू पक्ष कए फायदा भ सकैत अछि।





एकरऽ साथ ही पड़ोसी के बीच के संबंध म॑ चुनौती भी अनिवार्य रूप स॑ शामिल छै । व्यापार, सीमा प्रबंधन, जल संसाधन आ बुनियादी ढाँचा सं संबंधित मुद्दा पर लगातार संवाद आ आपसी समझदारी कें आवश्यकता छै. दूनू सरकारऽ के बीच रचनात्मक जुड़ाव स॑ ऐसनऽ मामला क॑ शांतिपूर्ण तरीका स॑ संबोधित करै म॑ मदद मिल॑ सकै छै आरू गलतफहमी क॑ व्यापक द्विपक्षीय संबंधऽ प॑ असर नै पड़॑ सकै छै ।





शाह केरऽ स्वतंत्रता दिवस केरऽ शुभकामना ई तरह स॑ एगो विधिवत संदेश स॑ भी अधिक छै । ई नेपाल केरऽ नया प्रशासन के तहत भारत के साथ मैत्रीपूर्ण आरू उत्पादक संबंध बनाबै के रुचि के संकेत दै छै । मोदी केरऽ पूर्व सहयोग केरऽ संदेश भी ऐन्हऽ ही भारत केरऽ नेपाल के साथ संबंध गहरा करै के इच्छा के संकेत दै छै ।





जेना-जेना दुनू देश भविष्य दिस देखैत अछि, आपसी सम्मान, समानता आ साझा हित पर आधारित सहयोग अनिवार्य रहत। नेपाल आ भारतक मित्रताक जड़ि गहींर अछि, मुदा ओकर भविष्य एहि बात पर निर्भर करत जे नव आर्थिक, सामाजिक आ क्षेत्रीय चुनौती पर दुनू पक्ष कतेक प्रभावी ढंग सँ प्रतिक्रिया दैत अछि ।





अतः भारत केरऽ स्वतंत्रता दिवस प॑ नरेंद्र मोदी क॑ प्रधानमंत्री बलेन्द्र शाह केरऽ शुभकामना दक्षिण एशिया म॑ पड़ोसी संबंधऽ के महत्व के याद दिलाबै के काम करै छै । निरंतर संवाद, जन-जन-जन-संपर्क मजबूत आ व्यावहारिक सहयोग नेपाल आ भारत आगामी वर्ष मे आओर घनिष्ठ साझेदारी बनेबा मे मदद क सकैत अछि ।

KATHMANDU: The PATA Nepal Chapter has received the PATA Award of Excellence for another year, earning fresh recognition for its work within the Pacific Asia Travel Association’s global network.

The award was presented at the PATA Chapter & Student Chapter Awards Ceremony in Kuching, Sarawak, Malaysia, ahead of PATA Travel Mart 2026.

According to the PATA Nepal Chapter and Nepal Tourism Board, the recognition reflects the continued efforts of the chapter’s executive committee and secretariat and its active engagement within the PATA network.

The chapter said the award has reaffirmed its position as one of the most active PATA chapters worldwide.

The chapter expressed gratitude to PATA headquarters for the recognition, saying it would further encourage its commitment to sustainable and responsible tourism development in Nepal and beyond.

The Nepal Tourism Board congratulated the chapter on the achievement and acknowledged its contribution to promoting sustainable, responsible and meaningful tourism.

description: Nepal Student Union Protests Gas Shortage  Ratopati
publisher.title: Ratopati
full_article:
Kathmandu. As the shortage of cooking gas in Nepal intensifies, the Nepal Students Union (NSU) has protested in front of Trichandra Campus in Kathmandu.

The NSU protested, accusing the government led by Balen Shah of being indifferent to solving the gas problem.

Students participating in the protest chanted slogans against the government, asking, 'Why is the Balen government so slow in solving the gas problem?' Students complained that even though consumers across the country are forced to wait in line for hours for gas, the concerned bodies have not taken concrete steps to solve the problem.

The students demanded that the smooth supply of gas be ensured and that black marketing and artificial shortages in the market be stopped immediately. NSU leaders have also warned that if the problem is not addressed promptly, the movement will be intensified.

title: Nepal President confers Honorary General rank on Indian Army chief - Manorama Yearbook
description: Nepal President confers Honorary General rank on Indian Army chief  Manorama Yearbook
publisher.title: Manorama Yearbook
full_article:
• Indian Army chief General Dhiraj Seth was conferred the rank of Honorary General of the Nepali Army by President Ramchandra Paudel during an investiture ceremony in Kathmandu on August 17.

• General Seth is on an official visit to Nepal from August 17 to 19 at the invitation of his Nepalese Army counterpart General Ashok Raj Sigdel.

• General Seth met General Sigdel at the Nepal Army headquarters.

• The two leaders discussed matters of mutual interest and ways to strengthen bilateral military relations.

• The conferment of the honorary rank is part of a unique and time-honoured military tradition under which India and Nepal reciprocally confer the honorary rank of General on the chiefs of each other’s armies.

• Commander-in-Chief General K.M. Cariappa was the first Indian Army chief to be decorated with the title in 1950.

• The tradition is more than a ceremonial honour and is an institutional expression of mutual trust, professional respect and military camaraderie between the two armies.

• Sustained across successive generations of military leadership, the ceremony therefore represents both tradition and strategic continuity.

• It underscores the commitment of the Indian Army and the Nepali Army to preserve their distinctive military relationship while strengthening cooperation in areas of mutual interest.

Defence cooperation between both countries

• The exchange of such high-level visits and continuation of tradition helps in strengthening relations between the two militaries and the two countries.

• The country shares a border of over 1,850 km with five Indian states — Sikkim, West Bengal, Bihar, Uttar Pradesh and Uttarakhand. Land-locked Nepal relies heavily on India for the transportation of goods and services.

• The India-Nepal Treaty of Peace and Friendship of 1950 forms the bedrock of the special relations that exist between India and Nepal. Nepalese citizens avail facilities and opportunities on par with Indian citizens in accordance with the provisions of the Treaty.

• Nearly 8 million Nepalese citizens live and work in India.

• India and Nepal have wide-ranging cooperation in the defence sector. India has been assisting the Nepal Army (NA) in its modernisation by supplying equipment and providing training.

• The ‘Indo-Nepal Battalion-level Joint Military Exercise Surya Kiran’ is conducted alternately in India and in Nepal.

• The Gorkha regiments of the Indian Army are raised partly by recruitment from hill districts of Nepal. Currently, about 32,000 Gorkha soldiers from Nepal are serving in the Indian Army.

• India and Nepal cooperate closely in areas such as countering narcotics, cross-border crimes, money laundering, etc, apart from strengthening interaction in training and capacity building in areas related to security matters.

• There are several bilateral mechanisms for discussing cooperation on security matters including border security.

• There is regular and mutually beneficial engagement between the law enforcement authorities of both sides on such issues.

• The signing of the agreement on Mutual Legal Assistance in Criminal Matters (MLAA) between India and Nepal in February 2026 will further enhance the effectiveness of investigation, prosecution and judicial proceedings in both countries for the prevention of cross-border crimes.

(The author is a trainer for Civil Services aspirants.)

दुनू देशक बीच रक्षा सहयोग

full_article:
Kathmandu, August 18

Spider-Man: Brand New Day is setting one record after another, both in Nepal and around the world. It has earned more than 2 billion dollars worldwide through its third weekend.

Variety magazine reported that the Tom Holland-starrer film earned 785 million dollars from North America and 1.23 billion dollars from international markets.

Its total earnings stand at 2.022 billion dollars. With this haul, Spider-Man: Brand New Day has become the eighth highest-grossing film of all time. It is the first Spider-Man film to cross the 2-billion-dollar mark.

In Nepal too, its earnings show no signs of slowing. As of Monday afternoon, the film’s gross earnings in Nepal exceed 156.3 million rupees. With this, the film has become the fifth highest-grossing foreign film in Nepal to date.

title: Nepal’s ODI status at stake as World Cup League 2 race enters final stage - english.onlinekhabar.com
description: Nepal’s ODI status at stake as World Cup League 2 race enters final stage  english.onlinekhabar.com

full_article:
Kathmandu, 17 August

The race in the ICC Cricket World Cup League 2 has become increasingly intriguing and challenging for Nepal following the results of the recently completed series involving Scotland, Canada and the UAE.

In the series held in Scotland, the hosts won three matches while the UAE won one, with two matches ending without a result.

Rain prevented the matches between Scotland and the UAE and Canada and the UAE from producing results. Scotland won both its matches against Canada, while the UAE defeated Canada in one match but lost to Scotland by one wicket.

Canada failed to win any match in the series. After earning one point from a no-result match, Canada moved one place above Nepal in the League 2 standings, pushing Nepal down to seventh.

Nepal is currently seventh with 24 points from 32 matches. Its chances of finishing in the top four and qualifying directly for the World Cup Qualifier have already become extremely difficult.

However, Nepal remains in a relatively strong position in the race to finish in the top six and retain its One-Day International (ODI) status.

Nepal now has only four matches remaining in League 2, with two matches each against Oman and Canada. The upcoming series will be Nepal’s final series in the League 2 campaign.

If Nepal fails to finish in the top six after the series, it could be locked into seventh or eighth place in the final standings and face the prospect of losing its ODI status.

Following Nepal’s poor performance in the previous series, the team has also undergone a captaincy change. Sandeep Lamichhane has replaced Rohit Paudel as captain.

Several key players have also been left out of the squad for the upcoming ACC Premier Cup, including Sompal Kami, Kushal Bhurtel and Bhim Sharki. The squad for Nepal’s final League 2 series has not yet been confirmed.

With a new captain at the helm, Nepal’s immediate challenge will be to win its remaining matches and preserve its ODI status. Captain Lamichhane has said the team will learn from its mistakes and move forward with better planning.

“We could not play the way we should have in our last two tours. We gave our best effort, but we fell short for various reasons,” he said. “Now we will correct our mistakes and move forward with better plans for the upcoming tour.”

League 2 standings

Scotland currently lead the standings with 45 points from 36 matches after completing all their games. The United States are second with 43 points from 32 matches, while the Netherlands are third with 38 points from 32 matches. All three teams are mathematically out of Nepal’s reach.

Oman are fourth with 31 points from 28 matches, followed by Namibia with 28 points from 32 matches and Canada with 25 points from 32 matches.

Nepal are seventh with 24 points from 32 matches, while the UAE are eighth with 18 points from 28 matches.

After the upcoming series involving Oman, Canada and Nepal, the United States, Namibia and the UAE will play a series, followed by a series between the UAE, Netherlands and Oman.

Slim chance of finishing in top four

Nepal’s only remaining route to a top-four finish and direct qualification for the World Cup Qualifier is to overtake fourth-placed Oman. However, Nepal would need to win all its remaining matches and rely heavily on results involving other teams.

Nepal must win all four of its remaining matches — two against Oman and two against Canada — to reach a maximum of 32 points. Even one defeat would end Nepal’s top-four hopes.

Oman, which currently has 31 points from 28 matches, has eight games remaining. Even if Nepal beats Oman in both of their upcoming matches, Oman would still have six matches left.

For Nepal to finish fourth with 32 points, Oman could collect no more than one additional point from those six matches, meaning Oman would have to lose at least five of them.

If Oman wins even one of its upcoming matches, Nepal would be eliminated from the top-four race.

Similarly, Namibia, which currently has 28 points, cannot collect more than four points from its remaining four matches if Nepal is to have a chance of overtaking it. Nepal would also need to beat Canada in both remaining matches and keep Canada below 29 points.

Race to retain ODI status

With direct qualification for the World Cup Qualifier now almost out of reach, finishing in the top six and retaining ODI status has become Nepal’s main and more realistic objective.

If Nepal fails to break into the top six after the series against Oman and Canada, its route to retaining ODI status will effectively be closed.

If Canada remains seventh after the series, Nepal’s main concern will be the UAE, which still has eight matches to play and could theoretically reach 34 points.

Nepal has several possible routes to the top six.

If Nepal wins three or all four of its remaining matches against Oman and Canada, it will finish with between 30 and 32 points. In that scenario, Nepal would move ahead of Canada and Namibia, although Namibia still has matches remaining and could potentially overtake Nepal.

If Nepal beats Canada in both matches but loses both games against Oman, it will finish with 28 points. Canada would remain behind Nepal if Nepal wins both matches against Canada and Oman also beats Canada at least once.

The UAE, currently on 18 points, has eight matches remaining and could theoretically reach 34 points. If the UAE produces an exceptional run and overtakes Nepal, Nepal could drop to seventh and Canada to eighth, although such a scenario remains difficult.

Therefore, beating Canada in both matches and reaching at least 28 to 30 points would be Nepal’s safest route to retaining ODI status.

The simplest route for Nepal is to win all four remaining matches. If Nepal fails to beat Canada and Oman, finishing in the top six will become extremely difficult.

Even if Nepal reaches the top six with a maximum of 32 points, its position would be secure unless the UAE wins all its remaining matches. If Nepal finishes on 26 or 28 points, however, it will have to depend on results from other teams.

बारिश के कारण स्कॉटलैंड आरू यूएई आरू कनाडा आरू यूएई के बीच के मैच के परिणाम नै निकललै । स्कॉटलैंड कनाडा के खिलाफ अपनऽ दूनू मैच जीती क॑ यूएई न॑ कनाडा क॑ एक मैच म॑ हरा देलकै लेकिन स्कॉटलैंड स॑ एक विकेट स॑ हारलऽ छेलै ।

कनाडा एहि सीरीज मे कोनो मैच जीतबा मे असफल रहल। नो-रिजल्ट मैच सँ एक अंक अर्जित करला के बाद कनाडा लीग २ के तालिका मे नेपाल सँ एक स्थान ऊपर आबि नेपाल के सातम स्थान पर आबि गेल ।

नेपाल एखन ३२ मैच मे २४ अंक प्राप्त कए सातम स्थान पर अछि । एकरऽ टॉप फोर म॑ जगह बनाबै आरू सीधा विश्व कप क्वालीफायर लेली क्वालीफाई करै के संभावना पहल॑ स॑ ही अत्यंत मुश्किल होय गेलऽ छै ।

लेकिन, नेपाल शीर्ष छह में जगह बनाबै के दौड़ में अपेक्षाकृत मजबूत स्थिति में बनलौ छै आरू एक दिवसीय अंतर्राष्ट्रीय (एकदिवसीय) के दर्जा बरकरार रखै छै ।

नेपाल केरऽ अब॑ लीग २ म॑ मात्र ४ मैच बची गेलऽ छै, जेकरा म॑ ओमान आरू कनाडा के खिलाफ दू-दू मैच छै । आगामी सीरीज लीग 2 अभियान मे नेपाल के अंतिम सीरीज होयत.

अगर नेपाल सीरीज के बाद टॉप छह में नै आबै छै त अंतिम रैंकिंग में सातवा या आठम स्थान पर बंद होय सकै छै आरू एकदिवसीय दर्जा खोबै के संभावना के सामना करना पड़॑ सकै छै ।

पिछला सीरीज मे नेपाल के खराब प्रदर्शन के बाद टीम के कप्तान पद मे सेहो बदलाव भेल अछि. रोहित पौडेल के जगह संदीप लामिछाने कप्तान बनल छथिन्ह.

आगामी एसीसी प्रीमियर कप लेली टीम स॑ भी कईएक प्रमुख खिलाड़ी क॑ बाहर रखलऽ गेलऽ छै, जेकरा म॑ सोम्पल कामी, कुशल भूर्टेल आरू भीम शार्की शामिल छै । नेपाल केरऽ अंतिम लीग २ सीरीज केरऽ टीम केरऽ पुष्टि अभी तलक नै होय सकलऽ छै ।

एकटा नव कप्तान के पतवार पर नेपाल के तत्काल चुनौती होयत जे ओ अपन शेष मैच जीतय आ अपन एकदिना के दर्जा के बरकरार राखय. कप्तान लामिछाने कहला अछि जे टीम अपन गलती स सीख लेत आ बेहतर योजना क संग आगू बढ़त।

ओ कहलनि जे, हम सब अपन पिछला दू दौरा मे जेना खेलय के चाही छल, ओहि तरहे नहि खेल सकलहुं, हम सब अपन पूरा प्रयास केलहुं, मुदा विभिन्न कारण स हम सब कम भ गेलहुं। “आब हम सब अपन गलती के सुधारब आ आगामी दौरा के लेल नीक योजना के संग आगू बढ़ब।”

लीग 2 के तालिका

स्कॉटलैंड अपनऽ सब खेल पूरा करला के बाद अभी ३६ मैचऽ स॑ ४५ अंक के साथ तालिका म॑ आगू छै । अमेरिका ३२ मैच मे ४३ अंक प्राप्त कए दोसर स्थान पर अछि, जखन कि नीदरलैंड ३२ मैच मे ३८ अंक प्राप्त कए तेसर स्थान पर अछि । तीनू टीम गणितीय रूप स नेपाल क पहुंच स बाहर अछि।

ओमान 28 मैच सं 31 अंक के संग चारिम स्थान पर अछि, जखन कि नामीबिया 32 मैच सं 28 अंक आ कनाडा 32 मैच सं 25 अंक के संग दोसर स्थान पर अछि.

नेपाल ३२ मैचमे २४ अंक प्राप्त कए सातम स्थानमे रहल अछि, जखन कि यूएई २८ मैचमे १८ अंक प्राप्त कए आठम स्थानमे अछि ।

ओमान, कनाडा आरू नेपाल स॑ जुड़लऽ आबै वाला सीरीज के बाद अमेरिका, नामीबिया आरू यूएई के बीच एगो सीरीज खेललऽ जैतै, जेकरा बाद यूएई, नीदरलैंड आरू ओमान के बीच सीरीज खेलतै ।

टॉप फोर मे जगह बनेबाक पतला मौका

विश्व कप क्वालीफायर के लेल शीर्ष चारि स्थान आ सीधा क्वालीफाइंग के लेल नेपाल के एकमात्र मार्ग शेष अछि चारिम स्थान पर रहल ओमान के पछाड़ब । मुदा नेपाल के अपन शेष सभ मैच जीतय के जरूरत पड़त आओर दोसर टीम के शामिल करय वाला रिजल्ट पर बेसि भरोसा करय पड़त.

नेपाल क॑ अधिकतम ३२ अंक पहुँचै लेली अपनऽ शेष चारो मैच – दू ओमान के खिलाफ आरू दू कनाडा के खिलाफ — जीतना छै । एक हार स सेहो नेपाल के टॉप फोर मे उम्मीद खतम भ जाएत.

फिलहाल 28 मैच मे 31 अंक प्राप्त करय वाला ओमान के 8 मैच बाकी अछि. नेपाल अपन आगामी दुनू मैच मे ओमान के हरा देत तखनो ओमान के छह मैच शेष रहत।

नेपाल क॑ ३२ अंक के साथ चारिम स्थान प॑ पहुँचै लेली ओमान वू ६ मैचऽ स॑ एक स॑ अधिक अतिरिक्त अंक नै जमा करी सकै छै, मतलब कि ओमान क॑ कम स॑ कम पाँच मैच हारना पड़ी जैतै ।

अगर ओमान अपन आगामी कोनो मैच मे सेहो जीत हासिल करत त नेपाल टॉप फोर के दौड़ सं बाहर भ जाएत.

तहिना एखन २८ अंक बनि रहल नामीबिया अपन शेष चारि मैच मे सँ चारि अंक सँ बेसी नहि बटोर सकैत अछि जँ नेपाल केँ ओकरा पछाड़बाक मौका भेटबाक अछि । नेपाल क॑ भी बाकी दूनू मैच म॑ कनाडा क॑ हराबै के जरूरत होतै आरू कनाडा क॑ २९ अंक स॑ नीचें रखै के जरूरत होतै ।

एकदिवसीय दर्जा बरकरार रखबाक दौड़

विश्व कप क्वालीफायर केरऽ सीधा क्वालीफाइंग अब॑ लगभग पहुँच स॑ बाहर होय गेलऽ छै, ई लेली शीर्ष छह म॑ जगह बनाबै आरू एकदिना के दर्जा बरकरार रखना नेपाल केरऽ मुख्य आरू अधिक यथार्थवादी उद्देश्य बनी गेलऽ छै ।

ओमान आरू कनाडा के खिलाफ सीरीज के बाद अगर नेपाल शीर्ष छह में नै आबी जाय छै त॑ एकदिवसीय के दर्जा बरकरार रखै के ओकरऽ रास्ता प्रभावी रूप स॑ बंद होय जैतै ।

अगर ई सीरीज के बाद कनाडा सातवां स्थान प॑ रहतै त॑ नेपाल केरऽ मुख्य चिंता यूएई प॑ होतै, जेकरा अभी आठ मैच खेलना बाकी छै आरू सैद्धांतिक रूप स॑ ३४ अंक तलक पहुँची सकै छै ।

नेपाल के शीर्ष छह में पहुंचय के कईटा संभावित मार्ग अछि.

ओमान आ कनाडा के खिलाफ शेष तीन या चारू मैच मे नेपाल जीत हासिल करत त 30 स 32 अंक के बीच मैच समाप्त करत। ओहि परिदृश्य मे नेपाल कनाडा आ नामीबिया स आगू बढ़त, हालांकि नामीबिया क एखनो मैच शेष अछि आ संभावित रूप स नेपाल कए आगू बढ़ा सकैत अछि।

यदि नेपाल दुनू मैच मे कनाडा के हराबैत मुदा ओमान के खिलाफ दुनू मैच हारैत अछि त ओ 28 अंक के संग समाप्त होयत। कनाडा के खिलाफ नेपाल दुनु मैच जीतत आ ओमान सेहो कम स कम एक बेर कनाडा के हरा देत त कनाडा नेपाल स पाछु रहत।

फिलहाल १८ अंक के साथ यूएई के आठ मैच बाकी छै आरू सैद्धांतिक रूप स॑ ३४ अंक तक पहुँची सकै छै । अगर यूएई असाधारण रन पैदा करी क॑ नेपाल क॑ पछाड़ी म॑ छोड़ी दै छै त॑ नेपाल सातवां आरू कनाडा आठवां स्थान प॑ गिरी सकै छै, हालांकि ऐसनऽ परिदृश्य मुश्किल बनलऽ छै ।

अतः दुनु मैच में कनाडा के हरा क कम स कम 28 स 30 अंक तक पहुंचब नेपाल के वनडे के दर्जा बरकरार रखबाक सबस सुरक्षित मार्ग होयत।

नेपाल के लेल सबस सरल मार्ग अछि शेष चारू मैच जीतब। अगर नेपाल कनाडा आ ओमान के पछाड़य मे असफल रहत त टॉप छह मे जगह बनाबय मे अत्यंत कठिनाई भ जाएत.

भले ही नेपाल अधिकतम ३२ अंक के साथ शीर्ष छह में पहुँची जाय, लेकिन जब तक यूएई अपनऽ बाकी सब मैच नै जीत॑ छै, ओकरऽ स्थिति सुरक्षित रहतै । मुदा, नेपाल 26 या 28 अंक पर खतम भ जायत त ओकरा अन्य टीम के रिजल्ट पर निर्भर करय पड़त.
